### **1. Growth & Retention Benchmarks**
* **Year-over-Year (YoY) Revenue Growth (Private B2B):** Overall median growth is **22%**.
  * **SMB Segment:** 28%
  * **Mid-Market Segment:** 22%
  * **Enterprise Segment:** 17%
  * *Source:* [The 2026 SaaS Benchmarks Report](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/2026-saas-benchmarks-report-ryan-allis-14kbf)
* **Net Revenue Retention (NRR):**
  * **Overall Median:** **102%** across all private B2B SaaS ([LinkedIn Report](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/2026-saas-benchmarks-report-ryan-allis-14kbf)).
  * **Enterprise Top-Quartile Benchmark:** **120% – 130%** NRR ([PM Toolkit](https://pmtoolkit.ai/learn/growth/saas-benchmarks-2026)).
  * NRR measures expansion revenue and cohort stability ([The Marketing Hub](https://the-marketinghub.com/blog/are-saas-models-still-viable-2026/); [SaaS Rise](https://www.saasrise.com/blog/the-2026-saas-funding-guide)).

### **2. Unit Economics & CAC Payback**
* **CAC Payback Formula:**  
  $$\text{CAC Payback (Months)} = \frac{\text{CAC}}{\text{Monthly ARPU} \times \text{Gross Margin \%}}$$  
  *(Sources: [CloudZero](https://www.cloudzero.com/blog/saas-unit-economics/), [re:cap](https://www.re-cap.com/blog/kpi-metric-saas))*
* **Payback Benchmark:** Top-performing SaaS companies achieve CAC payback in **under 12 months** ([CloudZero](https://www.cloudzero.com/blog/saas-unit-economics/)).
* **LTV:CAC Ratio:** Healthy SaaS models target an LTV:CAC ratio of **3:1** ([Lucid.now](https://www.lucid.now/blog/saas-unit-economics-pricing-for-growth/)).

### **3. ARPU & Gross Margins**

* **Gross Margins:** The 2026 market highlights emerging differences in gross margin bands comparing **traditional SaaS vs. AI-driven companies** ([SaaS Rise](https://www.saasrise.com/blog/the-2026-saas-funding-guide)).

### **4. Core Core KPIs for SaaS Founders (2026)**
Primary metrics required to evaluate viability include: **ARR, MRR, ARPU, Churn, CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, Gross Margin %, CAC Payback Period, and NRR** ([The Marketing Hub](https://the-marketinghub.com/blog/are-saas-models-still-viable-2026/)).', 'extras': {'signature': ''}}]
